name: DetectDominantLanguage
label: Detect Dominant Language (AWS Comprehend)
description: Identifies the dominant language of a given text using AWS Comprehend.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: Text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: The text to analyze for dominant language.

fields.name: Simplify
fields.label: Simplify
fields.description: If enabled, returns only the language code (e.g., 'en'). Otherwise, returns full response with confidence.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the Comprehend service is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: DetectedLanguage
fields.label: Detected Language
fields.description: The detected language code (e.g., 'en') or full result if Simplify is off.

fields.name: ConfidenceScore
fields.label: Confidence Score
fields.description: Confidence score (0–1) for the detected language.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS Comprehend.
